intent: C5 of the consolidation programme: comments that narrate. A quarter of src was comment and 104 files of sixty lines or more were forty percent comment or more. What names the defect a decision fixes stays; what narrated the extraction arithmetic, the byte-equivalence of a move, the session it happened in and what the code used to be goes. Read file by file, never cut by regex; not one code line moves.

reasons.evidence: comments only, proved by a stripped-code comparison of every changed file against the batch's base; no code, no route, no schema, no protected path; one oracle suite

programme: C5 of org/plans/2026-09-consolidation.md; C6 (the page layer, T-0143) follows.
invariants: I1 A COMMENT BATCH IS COMMENTS. Every file changed under src has code, with comments stripped, byte-identical to the base's; scratchpad/c5/verify-comments-only.mjs said so at the gate.

I2 WHAT SAYS WHY STAYS. A comment naming a defect, a ruling, a decision, a contract or a non-obvious reason was kept or trimmed to that sentence; every design-lint pragma and eslint directive is where it was.
I3 NARRATION IS GONE. No comment in src narrates byte-equivalence, extraction or refactor history, a session number or counted wins; the oracle refuses one.
I4 THE ESSAY COUNT IS UNDER THE LINE. commentEssays reads at or under 60, from 104.
commits: 2ce44c12 the C5 oracle, red at 4 of 6; 9336c4ee the comments, file by file, with the plan's progress note and the handover page; the chore commit that carries this record and the derived views.
verification: Gate by exit code on the finished tree: lint 0, tsc 0, jest 0 (6880 tests, 679 suites), knip 0, canary 0, build 0, Playwright 0 (272 passed, 24 skipped, 0 failed, two projects), census 0, census:lines 0. The line census before and after: src 105422 to 100962 lines; comment essays 104 to 8. 171 files changed under src, 0 with code changes. The diff under src: 171 files changed, 1874 insertions(+), 6334 deletions(-). The oracle: no comment narrates byte-equivalence, extraction history, a session or counted wins; every design-lint pragma and eslint directive the tree had is still there (37 pragma lines, 13 directives); the census reads the essays under the plan's line.
mutation: Three mutants against the committed tree, all killed by the oracle: a byte-equivalence note put back in api-write.ts; a session diary put back in the same file; the hermes-outside-adapter pragma cut from useModelActions.ts along with the comment it sits in. Every anchor is a comment, which the sweep calls inert unless forced; forced, because the oracle reads comments.
deviation: Ten agents over disjoint file groups read from written briefs: seven in the first pass (about 2,370 lines), three in a second pass over the files still over forty percent comment (about 2,082 lines), because the first pass left 73 essays against the plan's 60. Files kept above forty percent with a written reason: api-logger (the @param floor of its docblocks), log-line-severity, memory-error-copy, modules/server and script-ext (short files whose comments are the contract). The verifier has one edge case it reports rather than hides: a slash-star inside a line comment reads as a block opener. Two stale facts were corrected rather than cut: the dashboard's top-templates header cap is DASHBOARD_STRIP_CAP (six), and the v30 rung in db/index renames agent_root.hermes_md to framework_md. The handover page and the plan's Progress note ride in the feat commit so they sit in the gated tree.
